mirror.description: Mirror URL (http://, ftp://, file://, ssh:// supported).

target.description: Target directory or device for bootstrapping.

exclude_packages.description: Comma-separated list of packages to exclude. Only works for explicitly listed packages.

include_packages.description: Comma-separated list of extra packages to install.

keyring.description: Path or filename of GPG keyring. Relative paths searched in /usr/local/share/keyrings, /usr/share/keyrings, and CONFIGDIR.

allow_unauthenticated.description: Set to true to ignore unauthenticated packages (skips Release.gpg, keyrings, signatures).

download_only.description: Set to true to download only, skipping installation.

foreign.description: Set to true for foreign architecture (requires qemu-user-static).

quiet.description: Set to true for minimal output (warnings and errors only).

verbose.description: Set to true for verbose output (all command output shown).

debug.description: Set to true for debug output.
